verdict.rationale: Requesty documents drop-in compatibility with the official OpenAI SDK (just change base_url) and the official Anthropic Claude Code client via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, letting AI-native users build against standard, official SDKs without new clients. Missing for 10: evidence of a dedicated first-party Requesty SDK package (vs. compatibility shims) and independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK parity.
